negative_controls.boundary_rejection: record as boundary rejection, not real model-response negative-control proof
negative_controls.frame_order_adverse_meaning: association-reversal control: it checks that the scoring pipeline is sensitive to a wrong RGB-to-label association (the anchor and scale slots receive different physical cameras). It does NOT test temporal or cross-view reasoning of the teacher
negative_controls.frames: reverse RGB association [2,1,0], keep timestamp/GT score labels [0,1,2]

removed_controls.name: intrinsics_adverse
removed_controls.not_replaced: no substitute control is introduced by this amendment; a K-sensitive control needs its own pre-registration
removed_controls.reason: unsatisfiable by construction in this DA3 build: intrinsics are ignored unless extrinsics are supplied, so the prediction cannot depend on K and S_bad == S_clean < S_clean + max(0.0001, 0.1*S_clean)

negative_controls.same_clean_profile: all positive calls use the same model-estimated-K profile; no K is supplied to any call
negative_controls.unrelated_error: runtime/MPS/load failure is failure, not expected geometric rejection

known_risks: reference-view selection is discrete: with no cam_token DA3 picks the reference view by an argmin over 3 views and reorders. A flip of that argmin between CPU/MPS or fp32/fp16 changes the output frame and fails the elementwise gate by O(1) regardless of tolerance
the fp16 elementwise-all gate over ~3.5e5 elements is expected to be marginal; the tolerances are NOT relaxed by this amendment
numerical_parity.rule: all elementwise abs(a-b)<=atol+rtol*abs(reference); report max_abs and failed element counts; no relaxation after results

profile.assumption: no camera parameters are supplied to the teacher (neither intrinsics nor extrinsics); the teacher's own focal readout is descriptive only and is not a conditioning; not known-K conditioned, not blind intrinsic recovery, not metric scale, not Blender generalization

intrinsics_policy.ground_truth_K: recorded for the descriptive comparison only; never supplied to the teacher
intrinsics_policy.predicted_vs_ground_truth_K: report per view: predicted fx and fy and their ratios to the ground-truth fx and fy at the same resolution (process_res=280 gives 210x280, no rescale or crop); descriptive only, not part of the 7-vector, the score, the fit statistics or any threshold
intrinsics_policy.principal_point_excluded: DA3's camera decoder hard-codes the predicted principal point at (W/2, H/2); it is not estimated. The ground truth uses the pixel-centre convention ((W-1)/2, (H-1)/2), so the two differ by a constant 0.5 px convention offset that is not a model error. cx and cy are therefore excluded from the comparison.
